sources.title: XuejiFang/LeWAM · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Use this model · LeWAM predicts 32 robot actions per inference call using 10 denoising steps by default. This repository contains the LeWAM predictor, the frozen I-JEPA-Huge vision encoder, the scheduler, and RoboTwin action statistics. Download all weights together: hf download XuejiFang/LeWAM --local-dir outputs/lewam ·
